messages:
nina: quick heads-upi'm opening a docs PR to combine rate-limits + quota examples and add a small troubleshooting section. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/873

paul: can we include a tiny go/http example showing how to read X-Consumption-Units and X-Tier? customers using server-side libs ask about header access.

emma: yes, add go and curl. also add a worked example for a 10,000,000 tokens/month tier and a short note about how burst credits apply after tier exhaustion.

metrics-bot: Suggested metric query for panel: sum(rate(redwood_consumption_units_total[5m])) by (tier) -- verify with metrics team before embedding.

paul: also fixing two outdated links in pricing.md that reference /v0/ endpoints. i'll replace with /v1/ anchors and run snippet linter.

nina: thanks. i'll include a one-paragraph billing plain-language callout and anchor the troubleshooting section. once CI passes i'll request a review from kevin for wording.

emma: tiny nit: prefer header name X-Consumption-Units (singular) in all snippets to avoid confusion.

paul: noted. i'll update snippets.

nina: merging plan: bundle into one PR, backport to /v1 branch after kevin signoff. aiming to ship before docs freeze.
